description.value: Chinatown BBQ is an authentic Chinese barbecue restaurant situated in Vancouver's historic Chinatown on East Pender Street, specialising in house-roasted meats including honey-glazed BBQ pork, crispy roast pork, soy sauce chicken, and BBQ duck. The kitchen also produces an award-winning beef brisket curry and offers pre-order items like whole roasted duck and suckling pig. The restaurant has earned press coverage from the Globe and Mail, Vancouver Sun, and CBC, and has been recognised on 10Best.com for best value and best of Chinatown.

address.value: 130 East Pender Street, Vancouver, BC V6A 1T3

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is fully available and corroborates OSM contact details (address 130 East Pender St, phone 604-428-2626). The site explicitly confirms dine-in and takeout service and states 'We Are Now Open!' The menu lists several vegetarian dishes (Vegetable Egg Fried Rice, Gai Lan preparations, Potato Curry, Lettuce dishes). No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or charging anywhere on the site.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open, well-established Chinese barbecue restaurant in Vancouver's Chinatown with a confirmed address, phone, and active website — straightforwardly useful to touring cyclists seeking a hearty meal.
